<thought>All measured resistances are consistent with a single linear series network where each node’s distance from node A equals the measured resistance between A and that node. The differences between successive node distances give the individual resistor values. Listing the nodes in order from A to B (A, X1, N_b1, X2, N_c1, N_c2, N_c3, X3, N_d1, N_d2, N_d3, B) yields eleven resistors whose values match every measurement.</thought>
